snippet.title: Bumper Boss 2 0 Trailer
snippet.description:
Updated trailer for Bumper Boss! 

Updated the input system to support more controllers and had to re-build a lot of the game. Some UI will look different but the game is slightly more optimized and replaced the water!

Buy on Itchio: https://jayometric.itch.io/bumper-boss
Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1348040/Bumper_Boss/
